heading: What people are saying
intro: Sample feedback for the layout preview. Replace it with verified customer reviews before launch.

reviews.name: Maya Thompson
reviews.text: Mango Cloud keeps every client asset in one place. I can send a clean link instead of hunting through old email threads.

reviews.name: Daniel Brooks
reviews.text: Moving our team files took one afternoon, and everyone found what they needed without another training call.

reviews.name: Nora Patel
reviews.text: I use it for notes, project files, and photos. Having the newest version on my phone and laptop is a huge relief.

reviews.name: Jordan Lee
reviews.text: Shared folders make handoffs much smoother. New files appear for the whole team right away, with no follow-up needed.

reviews.name: Elena Rossi
reviews.text: Uploading a full shoot is simple, and I can give each client access to exactly the gallery they need to see.

reviews.name: Marcus Chen
reviews.text: The search is fast enough that I stopped duplicating files in folders just so I could find them later.
